subject.title: Gateway crash-loops with default Node heap (~4 GB) — make 'openclaw daemon install' set NODE_OPTIONS or accept a --heap-mb flag

question: Should OpenClaw land a fixed generated service heap default now, or require a durable heap-size tuning surface before resolving this crash-loop report?
rationale: The remaining choice is an availability and compatibility tradeoff for managed service defaults, not a missing narrow code location.

options.title: Land fixed default now
options.body: Accept the existing PR’s fixed 8192 MB generated service default as the emergency mitigation and track tunable heap sizing separately.

options.title: Require tunable surface first
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers choose a CLI or config surface and upgrade behavior for low-memory hosts and custom fleets.

options.title: Reject service heap change
options.body: Keep the current daemon behavior and ask for a different root-cause fix or stronger live reproduction before changing startup defaults.

recommendation.title: Land fixed default now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing PR’s fixed 8192 MB generated service default as the emergency mitigation and track tunable heap sizing separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline explicitly routed this report to steipete, and the remaining question is maintainer product direction on daemon defaults.
